title: Issue resolution and dealer visits
summary: This topic centers on dealer visits and whether issues were eventually resolved, but most sampled fragments are too brief or context-poor to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise helpful dealer staff and very good visit experiences.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on unresolved problems and continued waiting for wind or software issues to be fixed.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback pairs excellent branch service with issues that still needed sorting.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention something being sorted, finally resolved, or still unresolved without enough context to classify the overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are short and lack enough surrounding context for reliable sentiment interpretation.
The topic includes loosely connected mentions of visits, issue resolution, waiting, and even unrelated references such as relatives' cars, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of overall customer experience.
